title: Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) System Reference: Discounted Early Retirement Booking
content:
# Discounted Early Retirement Booking

*Member information system reference — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).*

## Rule for the booking

An approved request covers every distribution-margin allocation of the account that the general retirement resolution of the same year does not retire; a wholesale-supplier pass-through allocation is retired early only on the member's own election and never as part of this booking.

Each covered row is booked as one special retirement entry with retirement type discounted early for its gross, together with one payable entry for its payable, and the gross is the row's allocated amount less every general retirement already booked on that allocation year and source.

## What the booking does

The booking applies to a former member's capital account under a discounted early retirement request in board-approved status. Booking one covered row:

- records a special retirement entry of the discounted early type, source distribution margin, for the gross allocated amount retired;
- records the matching payable entry for the amount owed to the member net of the present-value discount — the discount kept by the cooperative being the gross less the payable;
- lowers the account's unretired credits by the gross and raises its retired credits owed by the payable.

The member can then see the retired amount owed on the capital credit account. One booking covers one distribution-margin allocation year; pass-through allocations are never booked this way.

## Invoking the tool

The tool is `book_early_retirement_114ff464`, an agent-side tool. It is unlocked with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then called by the agent with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `capital_account_id` | reference number of the member's capital credit account (one member in one patron class), as shown in the capital credit account lookup | identifier |
| `capital_request_id` | reference number of the board-approved discounted early retirement request, as shown in the capital credit request lookup | identifier |
| `allocation_year` | the patronage year of the allocation being retired, exactly as it appears on the allocation entry of the ledger | four digits, YYYY |
| `gross_retired_amount` | the allocated amount of that year still unretired and being retired now | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `payable_amount` | the amount owed to the member for that row net of the discount and any charge | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

The allocation source is not a parameter: the booking is always recorded as `distribution_margin`, with retirement type `discounted_early`.

### Return

A successful call returns `status` "booked", together with `retirement_entry_id` (reference of the special retirement entry), `payable_entry_id` (reference of the payable entry), `allocation_year` (YYYY), `allocation_source` (always `distribution_margin`), `gross_retired_amount`, `discount_amount` and `payable_amount` (USD, 2 decimals), and the account's new `unretired_balance` and `payable_balance` (USD, 2 decimals). The call succeeded when the status is booked.

### Illustration of the contract (hypothetical values)

Arguments: account `CA-0001`, request `CR-0001`, allocation year 2011, gross 300.00, payable 210.00. Return: status booked, allocation source distribution margin, gross 300.00, discount 90.00, payable 210.00, and the account's unretired credits lowered by 300.00 and retired credits owed raised by 210.00.
